children: ServiceTitan, Inc. reported third-quarter fiscal 2026 results, with revenue of $292.8M, a narrower net loss of $24.9M versus a $32.2M loss a year earlier, and diluted loss per share of $(0.26), improving from $(0.35) in the year-ago quarter.
Revenue was $292.8M for 3Q FY2026 (three months ended Jul 31, 2026), up from $242.1M in the year-ago quarter — 21.0% YoY.
Net income: Net loss $24.9M for 3Q FY2026, versus net loss $32.2M in the year-ago quarter (improvement YoY).
Diluted EPS was $(0.26) for 3Q FY2026, versus $(0.35) in the year-ago quarter (improved loss per share YoY).

Platform revenue growth remained strong, with platform revenue up 22% year-over-year for the quarter and 24% for the six-month period, driven by subscription growth (+22% for the quarter) and increased usage-based GTV.
Management tightened focus on existing commercial trades and residential roofing to prioritize Max AI upsell rather than expanding into new trades.
Active Customers were roughly 10,800, including more than 2,000 customers with annualized bookings (ABs) over $100K; net dollar retention exceeded 110% for the quarter.
Operational investment continued: R&D spend rose 38% for the quarter to support AI/Max initiatives and engineering hires, while platform gross margin improved to about 78.7%.
